hook: Your rocket launch can get hit by lightning.
title: Your rocket got hit by lightning twice
description:
Apollo 12 was struck by lightning twice in the first minute after liftoff in 1969. Systems dropped out, then came back, and the crew flew on to the Moon. Part of the series 'If You Were in Space'.

#Shorts #Apollo12 #Space
comment_prompt: Would you still fly? Yes or no
